column3: Close to the Hebrew; מִתַּעֲנִיתִי (“humiliation, self-abasement”) is rendered “fasting.”
Close to the Hebrew; יָתֵד (“a tent peg”) is rendered simply “a peg.”
NKJV renders “you have withheld downwards from our iniquity” as “punished us less than our iniquities deserve,” an interpretive paraphrase.
